events.title: Internet Explorer 7 released
events.summary: Microsoft shipped Internet Explorer 7 on October 18, 2006 with tabbed browsing, a [phishing] filter, and improved CSS support in Windows Vista.
events.about: IE 7 was Microsoft's first major browser update in five years — adding tabs years after Firefox popularized them. It shipped with Vista and tried to close the gap with Firefox 2 while IE 6 still dominated market share.

narrative.whyChosen: IE 7 was Microsoft's belated response to Firefox's resurgence.
narrative.whyImportant: Tabs and security features became baseline expectations for every browser.
narrative.problemSolved: IE 6 stagnation and security failures pushed users toward Firefox; Microsoft had to catch up.
